A '''tensor filed generator''' was a piece of technology used to produce a [[Tensor field/Legends|tensor field]]. The [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] was equipped with tensor field generators.<ref name="Complete Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref>
